code_review.followup_added: Budget preview for possible WPF CR/LF normalization; dense newline checks; exact original export equality retained.

validation_limits: Linux directory-handle pinning is not equivalent to Windows final-path checks; discovery is not a cross-time directory transaction snapshot.
Arbitrary malicious ancestor-directory replacement is not claimed eliminated.
Windows 8.3 aliases, ancestor junctions and redirected AppData can be conservatively refused; compatibility not physically tested.
Win32 file picker, confirmation and accepting export through the entire preview interaction are not automated.
Deterministic stream injection covers bounded growth/truncation/cancellation, not all physical filesystem races.
Windows CI aggregate metadata does not independently establish per-test counts, symlink skip details or portable package bytes.
Existing Forbidden logs and artifact 403 stop boundaries retained.
No production business requests, deployment, signing, installation, schema migration or public release.
